subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should bundled skill frontmatter descriptions be expanded with concise trigger/WHEN wording now, or should exact trigger semantics wait for a structured trigger metadata contract?
rationale: Current source still uses `description` as the model-visible selection signal, but docs and skill-creator guidance also push short descriptions and a separate open issue proposes a first-class trigger field; automation should not choose that public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve concise description cleanup
options.body: Allow one owner-reviewed metadata-only pass that keeps descriptions short, trigger-critical, and consistent with prompt-budget guidance.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep current concise descriptions and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the owner for exact trigger semantics and prompt contract changes.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that current noun-phrase descriptions are intentional and close broad trigger-phrase cleanup attempts as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve concise description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow one owner-reviewed metadata-only pass that keeps descriptions short, trigger-critical, and consistent with prompt-budget guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across skill guidance, docs, and the current prompt-visible formatter path.
